package domain_test

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestNewTeacherDialogJobQueuesOnlyActionContexts(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequestForJob(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued, job.Status)
	require.Empty(t, job.ErrorCode)
	require.Equal(t, now, job.NextAttemptAt)
}

func TestNewTeacherDialogJobQueuesLessonContext(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := validDialogRequestForJob()
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued, job.Status)
	require.Empty(t, job.ErrorCode)
}

func TestNormalizeTeacherDialogJobAcceptsPendingDeliveryWithoutDialogSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequestForJob(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobDeliveryPending
	job.DecisionID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	job.ResponseBody = "Проверь, какое значение должно получиться на последней итерации."
	job.Attempts = 1
	job.UpdatedAt = now.Add(time.Minute)

	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, job.ResponseBody, normalized.ResponseBody)
}

func TestNormalizeTeacherDialogJobRejectsUnboundedPendingResponse(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequestForJob(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobDeliveryPending
	job.DecisionID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	job.ResponseBody = strings.Repeat("я", 12001)
	job.Attempts = 1

	_, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(job)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestNewTeacherDialogJobAcceptsOutOfOrderDenseTurn(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := validDialogRequestForJob()
	request.SchemaVersion = 2
	request.TeacherTurnSequence = 2
	request.CanonicalStudentMessageID = request.SourceMessageID
	request.CorrelationID = request.SourceMessageID
	request.DialogCausationID = request.CanonicalStudentMessageID
	request.CausationID = request.EventID
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence)
	require.True(t, job.Request.UsesDenseTeacherOrdering())
}

func TestNormalizeTeacherDialogJobAllowsFailedNoEffectAttemptEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequestForJob(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobCompleted
	job.Attempts = 1
	job.ErrorCode = "student_unavailable"
	job.TerminalOutcome = domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect
	job.StudentCommandID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	job.NoEffectProofID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	job.RecoverableOutcomeID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(job)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, job.StudentCommandID, normalized.StudentCommandID)
}

func validDialogRequestForJob() domain.DialogTeacherRequest {
	return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 4, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 2,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 8, 59, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestT13BlockedPracticeRetainsOnlyGeneratedUndeliveredLegacyBody(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, contextType := range []domain.LearningContextType{domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, domain.LearningContextProject} {
		for _, state := range []domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState{"", domain.TeacherTurnUnknown, domain.TeacherTurnPartial, domain.TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled} {
			job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequestForJob(), now)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			job.Request.ContextType = contextType
			job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobBlocked
			job.Attempts = 1
			job.DecisionID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
			job.ResponseBody = "bounded pending response"
			job.ErrorCode = domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery
			job.ReconciliationState = state
			normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(job)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, job.ResponseBody, normalized.ResponseBody)
			for _, defect := range []string{"missing decision", "known delivered", "other context", "coordinator", "no attempt", "oversize", "invalid UTF8"} {
				t.Run(string(contextType)+"/"+string(state)+"/"+defect, func(t *testing.T) {
					invalid := job
					switch defect {
					case "missing decision":
						invalid.DecisionID = ""
					case "known delivered":
						invalid.DeliveredMessageID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
						invalid.ReconciliationState = domain.TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled
					case "other context":
						invalid.Request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLessonTask
					case "coordinator":
						invalid.CoordinatorMode = "onboarding_text"
					case "no attempt":
						invalid.Attempts = 0
					case "oversize":
						invalid.ResponseBody = strings.Repeat("界", 12001)
					case "invalid UTF8":
						invalid.ResponseBody = string([]byte{0xff})
					}
					_, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(invalid)
					require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob)
				})
			}
		}
	}
}
